name: One-Pot Meal Prep
equipment: A large pot or Dutch oven
instructions: Brown your protein first directly in the pot to build a flavor base, then set it aside.
Saute aromatics (onion, garlic) in the same pot, then add your starch (rice, pasta, or lentils) so it soaks up that flavor as it cooks.
Return the protein, add liquid (broth or water), cover, and simmer until the starch is fully cooked -- no separate pots needed.
Let it rest off the heat for a few minutes before portioning; it thickens and the flavors settle.
